description: The toggle on: `mcp_tailscale` is written and `/mcp` on Serve is checked. It's this host's already, so Serve isn't written to. Otherwise `tailscale serve --bg --https=443 --set-path=/mcp http://<tailscale-ip>:<mcp_port>/mcp` runs, and what it did is read back. Where a `/mcp` isn't this host's it stops with `conflict`, changing nothing, and so it does with Funnel on that name.
